Title: S3 Bucket Public Read/Write Allowed
RemediationAction: Enable S3 Block Public Access and restrict bucket ACLs immediately

Title: IAM User Admin Without Multi-Factor Authentication
RemediationAction: Enforce FIDO2 hardware token MFA on AWS root and administrative IAM principals

Title: Security Group Ingress Allows Port 22 from 0.0.0.0/0
RemediationAction: Restrict SSH ingress to corporate VPN gateway CIDR only

Title: EKS Cluster Control Plane Public Endpoint Active
RemediationAction: Change Kubernetes API server endpoint to private access only

Title: RDS Database Automated Snapshots Not Encrypted with KMS CMK
RemediationAction: Enable AES-256 customer-managed KMS key encryption on database backup storage
